answer: Funding-graph quarantine: a new agent's bond must come from an address that never paid another member of its cluster. The registry keeps a mirror of the transfer graph and pays only on paths at least three hops from a sibling. A sybil farm can still register, but every clone needs its own funded trail - separate deposits, fees paid twice, and a delay before rewards unlock. Ten thousand fakes cost ten thousand transfers plus float tied up meanwhile. Honest operators pay once. What is left is a sable roster of expensive clones beside a thin ivory column of independents.
